// AUTO-GENERATED by RAD IDE - RAD Hub worker for module __MODULE__ (do not edit).
//
// Serves the functions of __MODULE__.go over stdin/stdout (JSON lines):
//   stdin : {"id": 7, "func": "add", "args": [2, 3]}
//   stdout: {"id": 7, "result": 5}   or   {"id": 7, "error": "message"}
// Arguments are converted to the parameter types with encoding/json; a last result
// of type error becomes an error reply. fmt.Print output goes to stderr.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
)

const radModule = "__MODULE__"

var radFuncs = map[string]any{
__ENTRIES__}

var radErrorType = reflect.TypeOf((*error)(nil)).Elem()

func radInvoke(f any, args []json.RawMessage) (res any, errText string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			res, errText = nil, fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	fv := reflect.ValueOf(f)
	ft := fv.Type()
	n := ft.NumIn()
	if ft.IsVariadic() {
		if len(args) < n-1 {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("expects at least %d arguments, got %d", n-1, len(args))
		}
	} else if len(args) != n {
		return nil, fmt.Sprintf("expects %d arguments, got %d", n, len(args))
	}
	in := make([]reflect.Value, len(args))
	for i, a := range args {
		var t reflect.Type
		if ft.IsVariadic() && i >= n-1 {
			t = ft.In(n - 1).Elem()
		} else {
			t = ft.In(i)
		}
		p := reflect.New(t)
		if err := json.Unmarshal(a, p.Interface()); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Sprintf("argument %d: %v", i+1, err)
		}
		in[i] = p.Elem()
	}
	out := fv.Call(in)
	if k := len(out); k > 0 && ft.Out(k-1) == radErrorType {
		if !out[k-1].IsNil() {
			return nil, out[k-1].Interface().(error).Error()
		}
		out = out[:k-1]
	}
	switch len(out) {
	case 0:
		return nil, ""
	case 1:
		return out[0].Interface(), ""
	}
	list := make([]any, len(out))
	for i, v := range out {
		list[i] = v.Interface()
	}
	return list, ""
}

func radReply(w *os.File, id json.RawMessage, result any, errText string) {
	if len(id) == 0 {
		id = json.RawMessage("null")
	}
	// "id" must come first: the RAD Hub looks for lines starting with {"id"
	key := "result"
	var body []byte
	var err error
	if errText != "" {
		key = "error"
		body, _ = json.Marshal(errText)
	} else if body, err = json.Marshal(result); err != nil {
		key = "error"
		body, _ = json.Marshal("result is not JSON: " + err.Error())
	}
	line := `{"id":` + string(id) + `,"` + key + `":` + string(body) + "}\n"
	w.Write([]byte(line))
}

func main() {
	radWorker = true
	reply := os.Stdout
	os.Stdout = os.Stderr // fmt.Print* -> stderr
	radOut = os.Stderr
	lower := map[string]any{}
	for k, v := range radFuncs {
		lower[strings.ToLower(k)] = v
	}
	in := bufio.NewReaderSize(os.Stdin, 1<<20)
	for {
		line, err := in.ReadString('\n')
		if err != nil && line == "" {
			return
		}
		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
		if line == "" {
			continue
		}
		var req struct {
			ID   json.RawMessage   `json:"id"`
			Func string            `json:"func"`
			Args []json.RawMessage `json:"args"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &req); err != nil {
			radReply(reply, nil, nil, "bad request: "+err.Error())
			continue
		}
		f, ok := radFuncs[req.Func]
		if !ok {
			f, ok = lower[strings.ToLower(req.Func)]
		}
		if !ok {
			radReply(reply, req.ID, nil, fmt.Sprintf("%s has no function '%s'", radModule, req.Func))
			continue
		}
		res, errText := radInvoke(f, req.Args)
		radReply(reply, req.ID, res, errText)
	}
}
